text: The AirAsia brand's listed parent is AirAsia X Berhad, trading as AirAsia Group Berhad: in January 2026 it completed the acquisition of 100% of AirAsia Berhad and AirAsia Aviation Group Limited from Capital A, consolidating all of the group's airlines under the listed company. Co-founders Tan Sri Tony Fernandes and Datuk Kamarudin Meranun continue to be substantial shareholders via direct and indirect interests in the company.
short: AirAsia is owned by AirAsia Group Berhad (listed in Malaysia); co-founders Fernandes and Meranun are substantial shareholders.

source.name: AirAsia Newsroom: Tune Group Sdn. Bhd. ceases to be a substantial shareholder in AirAsia X Berhad in line with conditions set out in the circulars to shareholders in AirAsia's aviation business consolidation
source.quote: the co-founders, Tan Sri Tony Fernandes and Datuk Kamarudin Meranun will continue to be substantial shareholders via their direct and indirect interests in AirAsia X
source.note: The same AirAsia X Berhad statement describes 'the Proposed Acquisition by AirAsia X of 100% equity interest in AirAsia Aviation Group Limited and AirAsia Berhad' (completed; the acquired airlines then traded under the listed group).

additionalSources.name: The Edge Malaysia: Tune Group ceases to be substantial shareholder in AirAsia X after selling nearly 15% stake
additionalSources.quote: The plan, first unveiled in April 2024, involves the acquisition of AirAsia Aviation Group Ltd and AirAsia Bhd for RM6.8 billion by AirAsia X.
additionalSources.note: The Edge also reports Tony Fernandes holds a 2.5% direct stake in AirAsia X and Kamarudin Meranun 8.7% (as at January 2026, before Capital A's distribution of its AirAsia X shares to its own shareholders).
